EY Cyber Security Manager Offensive Security

Job Listing Detail

At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. Were counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

The Opportunity

Were looking for a Manager in our Cyber Security team with a strong focus on Offensive Security, Red Teaming, Cloudnative VAPT, and DevSecOps security assurance. Exposure to AI, ML, and GenAI security assessments is considered a desirable and goodtohave capability, as organizations increasingly adopt AIenabled technologies.

As part of our Cyber Technology Consulting practice, you will play a key role in leading and delivering offensive security services to clients across the MENA region. You will work with leading organizations across sectors including Financial Services, Government & Public Sector, Energy, Telecom, Healthcare, and Digital-native enterprises, helping them proactively identify vulnerabilities, simulate advanced adversaries, and strengthen their cyber resilience.

This role offers a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise, strategic advisory, and large-scale transformation, while contributing to the growth of our Offensive Security competency.

Your Key Responsibilities

Client Delivery And Engagement Management

  • Lead and deliver end-to-end offensive security engagements, including:
    • Network and infrastructure penetration testing
    • Web and mobile application security testing
    • API security assessments (REST, SOAP, GraphQL, microservices)
    • Cloud security testing across AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Plan and execute red team / adversary simulation / assumed breach exercises, emulating real-world threat actors to test organizational detection and response capabilities.
  • Execute and oversee purple teaming engagements, enabling alignment between offensive findings and defensive improvements (SOC, detection engineering, incident response).
  • Conduct and lead cloud offensive security assessments and validate effectiveness of controls across all layers and workloads within AWS, Azure, and GCP, including IAM, network, storage, container, serverless, and DevSecOps pipeline components.
  • Assess cloud misconfigurations, identity abuse paths, privilege escalation scenarios, insecure pipeline configurations, exposed secrets, and lateral movement techniques across hybrid and cloud native environments.
  • Perform penetration testing and security assessments of cloud native architectures, APIs, microservices, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, container images, and CI/CD pipelines to identify weaknesses across the secure software delivery lifecycle.
  • Assess and validate CSPM / CNAPP controls, identifying configuration gaps, privilege escalation paths, and exposure risks in cloud-native environments.
  • Deliver AI/GenAI security assessments, including (Desirable / GoodtoHave):
    • Prompt injection and adversarial input risks
    • Model misuse and abuse scenarios
    • Data leakage and insecure integration risks
    • AI governance and secure deployment considerations
  • Translate technical vulnerabilities into business risk insights, including attack paths, impact analysis, and prioritized remediation strategies.

Stakeholder Engagement And Advisory

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to CISOs, CIOs, security leaders, and engineering teams, articulating security risks in a business-relevant and outcome-driven manner.
  • Present complex offensive security findings to both technical and executive audiences, tailoring messaging appropriately.
  • Support clients in developing offensive security roadmaps, maturity models, and remediation programs aligned to leading practices.

Practice And Capability Development

  • Contribute to building the Offensive Security practice, including:
    • Development of methodologies, testing playbooks, and accelerators
    • Creation of reusable assets and frameworks
    • Standardization of delivery approaches and quality benchmarks
  • Support go-to-market initiatives, thought leadership, and client pursuits:
    • RFP/RFI responses
    • Solution positioning and capability presentations
    • Market-facing content development (whitepapers, POVs)
  • Stay ahead of evolving threat landscape, including:
    • Advanced attacker techniques and exploit trends
    • API and cloud-native attack vectors
    • AI/ML security risks and emerging vulnerabilities

People Leadership And Team Development

  • Manage and mentor a team of consultants and senior consultants, fostering:
    • Deep technical capability in offensive security domains
    • High-quality delivery and reporting standards
    • Continuous learning and certification progression
  • Provide performance feedback, coaching, and career guidance aligned with firm values.
  • Build a collaborative, high-performance culture within the Offensive Security team.

Skills and Attributes for Success

  • Strong hands-on expertise in offensive security methodologies, including penetration testing, exploit development, adversary simulation, and attack path analysis.
  • Deep understanding of:
    • OWASP Top 10 and API Security Top 10
    • Authentication and authorization mechanisms (OAuth, JWT, SSO, etc.)
    • Business logic vulnerabilities and modern application architectures
  • Proven experience in API security testing and microservices environments.
  • Strong working knowledge of cloud security risks, including:
    • Misconfigurations, IAM weaknesses, secrets exposure, lateral movement
    • Cloud-native architectures and shared responsibility model
  • Familiarity with CSPM, CNAPP, and CIEM concepts and their practical implementation.
  • Awareness of AI security risks, including adversarial attack techniques, prompt injection, and model governance concerns.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with attention to detail.
  • Ability to convert complex technical findings into clear, risk-based narratives.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and consulting skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple engagements in parallel with strong quality and delivery discipline.

To Qualify for the Role, You Must Have

  • A bachelors or masters degree in cyber security, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related discipline.
  • 1014 years of experience in Cyber Security, with strong focus on Offensive Security and advanced VAPT.
  • Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security, SANS Top 25, and MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Hands-on experience delivering:
    • VAPT engagements across network, application, API, and cloud layers
    • Red team / adversary simulation exercises
    • Cloud security assessments
    • Proven experience delivering Red Team, Cloud native penetration testing, and DevSecOps security validation engagements across modern engineering environments.
    • Hands on experience testing AWS, Azure, or GCP environments, modern application stacks, CI/CD platforms, containerized workloads, and infrastructure as code implementations.
  • Experience working in a consulting or professional services environment, managing clients and engagements.
  • Strong reporting, documentation, and presentation skills.
  • Proven ability to work in global and cross-cultural environments.
  • Willingness and flexibility to travel across the MENA region, as required.
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, OSCE, CRTO, GWAPT, GPEN, or equivalent.

Experience in:

  • Advanced red teaming and purple teaming engagements
  • API security and cloud offensive security
  • AI/LLM application security testing
  • DevSecOps and CI/CD pipeline security
  • Container and Kubernetes security

Exposure to:

  • BAS tools and attack simulation platforms
  • EDR/XDR validation and detection engineering
  • Regulatory and industry frameworks relevant to MENA

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals who bring:

  • A growth mindset and passion for offensive security
  • The ability to balance deep technical expertise with business acumen
  • Strong client-centricity and relationship-building capability
  • A collaborative approach to problem-solving and innovation
  • A commitment to quality, integrity, and continuous improvement

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

AI Data Protection Field Engineer

Role summary

We are looking for an AI Data Protection Field Engineer to help deploy, integrate, test, and troubleshoot AI-enabled data protection solutions for global clients. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on helping clients secure sensitive data across cloud, SaaS, endpoint, collaboration, and AI-enabled environments by combining strong data protection fundamentals with practical AI engineering skills. The role is designed for professionals with early-career to mid-career experience who enjoy solving real client problems in delivery settings and building technical depth in modern data protection. The internal role design emphasizes deployment, model/platform integration, testing, and troubleshooting, while comparable market roles emphasize customer-facing engineering, rapid iteration, and production-grade solution delivery.

Key responsibilities

  • Configure, deploy, and support AI-enabled data protection capabilities across client environments, including data discovery, classification, DLP-aligned controls, PKI/KMS integrations, and information rights management patterns.
  • Integrate data protection platforms with AI models, copilots, and enterprise workflows to help clients protect sensitive information used in prompts, retrieval sources, generated outputs, and broader AI use cases.
  • Execute implementation, validation, testing, and troubleshooting tasks for client deployments, including configuration tuning, issue identification, root-cause analysis, and stabilization support.
  • Support workshops, technical assessments, pilots, and proof-of-value activities by translating business and security requirements into practical engineering tasks. External field/FDE patterns emphasize embedding closely with customers and iterating quickly based on feedback, which should be reflected in this role.
  • Contribute to reusable playbooks, deployment guides, code snippets, engineering templates, and configuration standards that improve repeatability across engagements. Reusable accelerators and reference implementations are a common requirement in comparable AI engineering roles.
  • Work with cross-functional teams spanning cybersecurity, privacy, AI engineering, cloud, and client stakeholders to deliver secure and workable outcomes.

Required qualifications

  • Up to 5 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: data protection, DLP, information protection, data discovery/classification, security engineering, cloud security, or related cybersecurity engineering domains.
  • Working knowledge of data protection fundamentals, including data discovery and classification, DLP concepts, PKI & KMS, and information rights management.
  • Practical familiarity with AI/ML concepts relevant to data protection, including machine learning, deep learning, NLP, RAG, AI-assisted prioritization, and model risk scoring.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience writing small scripts, automations, or integrations in Python.
  • Familiarity with cloud-native deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP, and basic understanding of APIs and enterprise integrations. Comparable AI delivery roles frequently require these capabilities.

Join a globally connected cybersecurity practice helping clients protect sensitive data in an AI-driven world. You will work at the intersection of data protection, privacy, cloud, and frontier AI helping shape practical, scalable solutions that reduce risk, enable trust, and support secure business transformation. This is consistent with the internal positioning of the data protection practice as technology-enabled, consulting-led, and globally delivered.

title: Software Engineer (SRE)
jobDescription:
Role Summary

The SRE Engineer will play a key role in the Sophos development process by facilitating, managing, communicating, and automating tasks for the deployment and configuration of continuous feature builds for multiple development teams. By leveraging knowledge and expertise in the deployment of SaaS applications and microservices hosted in the cloud, the SRE engineer will streamline the process of quick and frequent automated builds and help elevate the Sophos development process to the next level of agility. As a member of the Sophos SRE team, you will work closely with software engineers, architects, product management and others to design and build the foundational toolset and capabilities that allow Sophos developers to quickly bring new features to market.

What You Will Do

  • Provide technical skillset to the SRE team by planning and designing SRE toolsets and automation.
  • Participate in architecture and security reviews for SRE Projects
  • Evangelize cloud technologies and CI/CD solutions for wider engineering teams
  • Focus on developing tools and processes for secure development practice.
  • Collaborate with multiple feature development teams to identify needs for building and deploying their applications.
  • Deploy and configure daily iterative builds of applications and containers into Tomcat server and Kubernetes clusters for multiple feature development teams. Deploy and configure MongoDB test databases with test data.
  • Design and implement automation for deployment and configuration tasks
  • Identify cloud infrastructure needs for deployment environments and manage costs.
  • Troubleshoot failed builds and deployments. Determine and fix environment and configuration issues. Analyze logs and communicate potential code issues to development teams.
  • Facilitate, manage and communicate information related to environments - their current state, deployed versions and availability to developers, QA engineers and team members.

  • Support services and applications 24/7 by participating in an on-call rotation.

What You Will Bring

  • 2-4 years with some of the following technologies JAVA, Groovy, Python, Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Strong knowledge with scripting languages, preferably Python and Groovy
  • Experience with build tools like Gradle, Maven, NPM
  • Experience supporting production grade systems including Linux administration, deployment, high availability durability, practical logging monitoring, and cost optimization in a public cloud, preferably AWS
  • Hands on experience with Terraform
  • Knowledge of AWS services including EC2, ECS, EKS, Fargate, IAM, CloudWatch, SQS, SNS, S3 is preferrable.
  • Kubernetes and container orchestration experience a big plus
  • Experience with Blue/Green deployments is preferred
  • Experience with CI/CD tools and automation methodologies, specifically Jenkins
  • Strong working knowledge of Docker and the container ecosystem
  • Excellent operational knowledge of Linux operating systems
  • Administration and automation skills with developer tools like Bitbucket, Artifactory
  • Some experience with CI/CD automation for DevSecOps tools like Sonar, Blackduck

DAU invites applications from outstanding candidates for faculty positions in Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence at the Assistant Professor and Associate Professor levels.

While applications from all areas of Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence are welcome, the University is particularly interested in candidates with expertise in the following domains:

  • Computer Systems and Networking: Operating Systems; Computer Networks; Distributed Systems; Cloud Computing; High-Performance Computing.
  • Software Engineering and Data Management: Databases; Data Mining; Data Warehousing; Software Design and Architecture; System Analysis and Design; Code Analysis and Software Quality Assurance; Software Testing and Verification.

  • Natural Language Processing and Information Retrieval: Natural Language Processing (NLP); Large Language Models (LLMs); Knowledge Representation and Reasoning; Information Retrieval and Search Technologies.

Minimum Eligibility Criteria

Candidates must satisfy the following minimum requirements:

  • A Ph.D. degree in a relevant discipline, with a First Class or equivalent grade in the preceding degree(s), and an excellent academic record throughout; and
  • A strong and sustained research record, evidenced by publications in reputed peer-reviewed journals and leading international conferences.

Assistant Professor

Applicants should possess a Ph.D. degree, demonstrated research potential, and a strong commitment to excellence in teaching at both undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Candidates with postdoctoral research experience and evidence of independent research capability will be given preference.

Associate Professor

Applicants should have a minimum of six years of post-Ph.D. experience in teaching, research, or relevant professional practice, of which at least three years should be at the level of Assistant Professor (or an equivalent position) at a higher educational institution or research organization.

Candidates are expected to have an established record of scholarly achievement, demonstrated through:

  • High-quality publications in reputed journals and conferences;
  • Success in securing externally funded research grants and projects;
  • Experience in supervising doctoral students and mentoring research scholars; and
  • Evidence of academic leadership and professional contributions to the discipline.

Industry Professionals

The University also welcomes applications from candidates with significant industry experience and a strong research and innovation profile. Professionals who have made substantial contributions to research, product development, technology innovation, or industrial RD and are passionate about teaching and mentoring students are encouraged to apply.

The University particularly values candidates who can bridge academia and industry through collaborative research, technology transfer, entrepreneurship, and experiential learning initiatives.

Salary per year in Cost to the Institute (CTI) format

Assistant Professor: Minimum starting salary is 20 Lakh per annum.
(Exceptionally qualified and experienced candidates may be considered for higher compensation and additional incentives commensurate with their credentials, achievements, and potential contributions.)

Perquisites Benefits

Research Support and Professional Development

  • Seed Research Grant: Up to 10 Lakh to support the establishment of research activities and laboratory infrastructure.
  • Professional Development Allowance: A cumulative allowance of 3 Lakh every three years (on a reimbursable basis) to support participation in national and international conferences, workshops, and other professional development activities.
  • Research Excellence Incentive: Financial reward of 1 Lakh for each publication in top-tier A/A-ranked conferences and Q1 journals.

Health, Insurance and Other Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical Insurance: Health insurance coverage of up to 10 Lakh per annum for the faculty member and eligible family members under a floater policy. The entire premium is borne by the Institute.
  • OPD medical reimbursement: 5000 per month for OPD medical expenses.
  • Children Education Allowances: 50000 per year ( 25000 per child, and coverage up to two children.)
  • Leave Travel Concession: 1.5 Lakh for a 4-year block.

Leave and Work-Life Balance

  • Casual Leave: 8 days per year.

  • Earned Leave Encashment: Accumulated earned leave is encashable upon separation from the University, as per applicable policies.

Career Growth

  • Career Progression (Policy): A transparent and well-defined faculty career advancement framework that recognizes excellence in teaching, research, and institutional service.
  • Teaching Load: Faculty members typically teach three courses per academic year. To facilitate a smooth transition, newly appointed faculty members are assigned a reduced teaching load of two courses during their first year (one course per semester).

Research Collaboration and Industry Engagement

DAU actively encourages faculty members to pursue collaborative research and innovation initiatives with leading academic institutions, research laboratories, government agencies, and industry partners in India and abroad. The University provides a supportive environment for securing external research funding, undertaking interdisciplinary projects, and translating research outcomes into societal and industrial impact.

title: Lead Generation : Definition & Meaning
tagsAndSkills: conversion optimization,brand building,cold calling,back office,ai,business development,advertising,brand strategy
jobDescription:
Lead generation is the systematic process of identifying and attracting potential customers who demonstrate interest in a company's products or services.

What Is Lead Generation

Marketing teams, sales professionals, and business development specialists use lead generation to build sustainable revenue pipelines, reduce customer acquisition costs, and achieve predictable growth targets through systematic prospect identification and engagement processes.

What Are The Primary Lead Generation Methods Used By Marketing Teams

Marketing teams implement 8 primary lead generation methods to attract and capture qualified prospects. These lead generation approaches are listed below:

  • Content marketing: Organizations create valuable blog posts, whitepapers, ebooks, and educational resources to attract prospects searching for industry solutions and expertise
  • Search engine optimization: Marketing teams optimize website content and landing pages to rank higher in search results for keywords that potential customers use during research phases
  • Pay-per-click advertising: Companies run targeted ads on Google, LinkedIn, Facebook, and other platforms to capture leads actively searching for specific products or services
  • Email marketing campaigns: Organizations send targeted email sequences to newsletter subscribers, webinar attendees, and content downloaders to nurture relationships and generate sales opportunities
  • Webinars and events: Companies host virtual and in-person events, trade shows, conferences, and educational sessions to demonstrate expertise and collect contact information from attendees
  • Referral programs: Businesses incentivize existing customers, partners, and industry contacts to recommend qualified prospects through structured referral systems and reward programs
  • Cold outreach: Sales development representatives contact potential customers through phone calls, LinkedIn messages, and personalized emails based on targeted prospect lists and research

What Are the Types of Lead Generation

Lead generation encompasses 6 primary types that businesses use to attract and capture potential customers. These lead generation approaches are listed below based on their channel characteristics and targeting methods.

  • Content marketing, SEO, social media Attracting prospects through valuable content
  • Cold calling, email campaigns, direct mail Proactively reaching out to potential customers
  • PPC advertising, social ads, display campaigns Capturing leads through online advertising
  • Event-Based Lead Generation Trade shows, webinars, conferences Generating leads through direct engagement
  • Customer referrals, partner networks Leveraging existing relationships for new leads
  • Account-Based Lead Generation Targeted campaigns, personalized outreach Focusing on specific high-value accounts

What Are the Key Components of Lead Generation Systems

Effective lead generation systems contain 5 essential components that work together to identify, capture, and nurture potential customers throughout the sales funnel.

  • Lead Magnets Valuable content offers like whitepapers, ebooks, webinars, or free trials that attract prospects and encourage contact information sharing.
  • Landing Pages Dedicated web pages designed to convert visitors into leads through compelling copy, clear value propositions, and optimized conversion forms.
  • Lead Capture Forms Data collection mechanisms that gather prospect information including name, email, company, and qualifying questions to assess lead quality.
  • Lead Scoring Systems Automated frameworks that assign point values to leads based on demographics, behavior, and engagement level to prioritize sales follow-up.
  • Lead Nurturing Workflows Automated email sequences and content delivery systems that educate prospects and maintain engagement until they reach sales-ready status.

What Is Lead Generation Formula

Lead Conversion Rate Formula

Lead Conversion Rate = (Number of Converted Leads Total Number of Leads) 100

This formula measures how effectively leads progress through the sales funnel, with each variable representing critical performance indicators:

  • Number of Converted Leads represents prospects who completed the desired action, such as making a purchase, signing a contract, or scheduling a consultation within the measurement period.
  • Total Number of Leads includes all qualified prospects who entered the sales funnel during the same timeframe, regardless of their final conversion status.
  • Conversion Rate Percentage indicates the efficiency of the lead nurturing process, with industry benchmarks ranging from 2-5% for most B2B sectors and 1-3% for B2C markets.

Sample Lead Generation Calculation

A software company generates 500 leads through digital marketing campaigns and converts 25 leads into paying customers during Q1.

Step 1: Identify converted leads = 25 customers

Step 2: Identify total leads = 500 prospects

Step 3: Apply formula = (25 500) 100

Step 4: Calculate result = 0.05 100 = 5%

The 5% conversion rate indicates above-average performance for B2B software sales, suggesting effective lead qualification and nurturing processes that convert 1 in every 20 prospects.

Important Considerations

Lead quality varies significantly across acquisition channels, making total volume metrics misleading without segmentation by source, qualification criteria, and conversion timeframes. Track conversion rates separately for each marketing channel to identify the most cost-effective lead generation strategies.

What Are Lead Generation Related Terms

Lead generation intersects with 7 distinct business development concepts that professionals often confuse or misapply. These related terms represent different stages, approaches, and outcomes within customer acquisition strategies.

Key Distinction from Lead Generation Creates market awareness and interest before capturing leads Brand building and market education campaigns Evaluates and scores existing leads for sales readiness Sales process optimization and resource allocation Develops relationships with existing leads over time Marketing automation and customer journey management Complete process from initial contact to paying customer Strategic planning and performance measurement Researches and identifies potential customers before contact Outbound sales strategy and target market analysis Improves rates at which visitors become leads or customers Digital marketing and website performance improvement Tracks and manages entire customer journey from awareness to purchase Sales operations and revenue forecasting

Lead Generation vs. Demand Generation

Lead generation captures contact information from prospects who already show interest, while demand generation creates that initial interest through market education and brand awareness campaigns. Demand generation precedes lead generation in the customer acquisition timeline.

Lead Generation vs. Lead Qualification

Lead generation focuses on quantity by attracting and capturing prospect information, while lead qualification emphasizes quality by evaluating which leads possess genuine purchase intent and budget authority. Qualification follows generation in sales processes.

Lead Generation vs. Lead Nurturing

Lead generation obtains initial prospect contact information through single interactions, while lead nurturing develops ongoing relationships with those prospects through sequential communications over weeks or months until they reach purchase readiness.

Lead Generation vs. Customer Acquisition

Lead generation represents one component within customer acquisition by providing potential buyer contact information, while customer acquisition encompasses the complete journey from initial awareness through final purchase and onboarding activities.

Lead Generation vs. Prospect Development

Lead generation uses inbound methods to attract prospects who voluntarily provide contact information, while prospect development employs outbound research to identify and contact potential customers who have not yet expressed direct interest.

Lead Generation vs. Conversion Optimization

Lead generation creates systems and campaigns to attract potential customers, while conversion optimization analyzes and improves the performance of existing lead generation assets to increase response rates and contact capture efficiency.

Lead Generation vs. Sales Funnel Management

Lead generation feeds prospects into the top of sales funnels through specific acquisition activities, while sales funnel management oversees the entire pipeline from initial contact through closed deals, including lead generation as one input component.

What Are the Core Distinctions Between These Terms

5 fundamental differences separate lead generation from related customer acquisition concepts across timing, scope, and measurement criteria.

  • Timeline Position: Lead generation occurs at specific points in customer journeys, while demand generation happens earlier and customer acquisition spans the entire process from awareness to purchase.
  • Success Metrics: Lead generation measures contact capture.

Role: Data Scientist Rider Growth

Location: Bangalore

Experience: 3–5 yrs

About LoadShare

LoadShare is one of India’s most innovative and resilient logistics platforms, transforming how goods move across the country. Founded in 2017, we’ve grown to become a pan-India, multi-category last-mile network with a unique presence in both Tier 1 metros and deep Tier 2/3 towns.

What sets us apart:

  • Scale with depth: We handle ~550K deliveries/day across food, e-commerce (B2C), B2B retail, and digital commerce, powered by a 30,000+ rider network.
  • Strong financials, stronger ambition: With 800+ Cr in FY26 revenue and support from global investors (Tiger Global, Matrix, BII, Stellaris, BeeNext), we have a long runway and a path to profitability.
  • Dual-engine model: We not only operate India’s most flexible last-mile delivery network, but also license our in-house logistics tech platform that processes an additional 20 lakh orders/day — one of the few in India to enable asset cross-utilization across verticals.
  • Strong Tech: We are in a unique position to cross-utilize the delivery boys across different earning opportunities matching the peaks of various use-cases throughout the day. (ex: grocery peaks at 6-8 am, while bike taxi peaks from 8 to 10 am, etc). In addition to this, our supply chain SaaS platforms power over 1M+ shipments per day.
  • Strategic partner to India’s digital economy: We work with every major digital commerce player (ecomm, quick commerce, food, mobility) , and are expanding wallet share and capabilities within existing giants while co-creating new models with emerging platforms and brands.
  • Built to scale profitably: We’re not chasing GMV at all costs. We’re building the most capital-efficient, tech-enabled logistics engine in the country. We’re now building for our next phase: a 5X scale-up over the next 5 years, anchored in sharper client focus, deeper solutions, and new growth engines.

Founders/ Founding team:

  • Raghu Talluri (CEO) - Formerly at Myntra, McKinsey
  • Pramod Nair (CTO) - Formerly at Freecharge, Snapdeal, MartMobi
  • Rakib Ahmed (Co Founder, Head EComm/ Trucking/Warehousing)- Formerly at ICICI Prudential, Co founder Lunate Eco

The Role: Where Growth Meets Data Science

We're hiring a Data Scientist for the Rider Growth charter of LoadShare Product Org. This role goes beyond preparing data, conducting analysis and building dashboards. Your job starts where that ends: figuring out why a metric moved, and turning that into experiments and models that move it.

Your will look at the entire lifecycle of riders - acquisition, activation, retention, revenue and referral. You will own the why behind every growth metric and convert it into experiments and models that move the needle.

What You'll Work On

  • Causal analysis & RCA: Establish causation, not correlation, for why acquisition/activation/retention metrics move. Use controlled experiments, diff-in-diff, and quasi-experimental methods to move the team from "what happened" to "why, and what to do next."
  • Dynamic offers & incentives (ML): Build models for personalized/dynamic offers to address new rider hiring, engagement and reactivation at the right place and right time, balancing uplift in DAU and CAC.
  • Experimentation muscle: Design, run, and read rigorous A/B tests; own lift measurement; build the experimentation discipline so launches stop being "assume and ship."
  • Segmentation & cohorting: Rider and funnel segmentation, retention/cohort curves, and driver/decision-tree analysis to find the patterns that explain behaviour.
  • Forecasting & churn (retention side): Predict supply needs, churn risk, and recovery to inform retention and re-engagement strategy.

What We're Looking For

  • 3-5 years in Data Science/ML
  • Strong first principles — the core bar.
  • Python and practical ML: segmentation, decision trees, regression, and basic causal-inference methods.
  • Real grounding in experimentation and statistics — A/B testing, controlled experiments, reading lift honestly.
  • AI-native: uses Claude/LLM tooling to accelerate analysis
  • Strong communication, comfort being embedded with a PM and business teams, and a bias for action.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Growth, activation, or retention analytics or ML modelling experience.
  • Experience with dynamic pricing/incentives, geospatial data, or experimentation platforms.

The Analyst Supply Solutions is responsible for delivering accurate and timely purchase order execution while elevating the function from transactional processing to AI-enabled, data-driven decision support.   • Order cycles run on time with high transaction quality and clear exception ownership.

  • Supplier delay risks are identified early, triaged correctly, and resolved through structured action plans.
  • AI and automation improve speed, consistency, and quality of operational decisions.
  • Cross-functional governance is reliable, transparent, and outcome-focused.

Core Responsibilities

  • Execute weekly ordering for replenishment and non-replenishment purchase orders with strong data accuracy.
  • Manage the PO lifecycle, including revisions, status tracking, exception logging, and issue closure.
  • Coordinate supply chain interruption updates (for example: factory constraints, shipment slippages, and recovery plans).
  • Publish concise progress updates for business stakeholders with clear decisions, actions, and ownership.
  • Maintain SOPs and control documents with disciplined versioning and audit readiness.

B. AI and Advanced Analytics (Mandatory)

  • Analyze demand, forecast, and order signals to detect outliers, risk clusters, and recurring root causes.
  • Use AI-assisted tools responsibly for anomaly detection, prioritization logic, and insight generation.
  • Develop practical analytical frameworks to separate urgent exceptions from low-impact noise.
  • Convert complex analysis into simple business narratives for planners, merchants, and leadership teams.
  • Build scalable KPI views and dashboards that improve action speed and accountability.
  • Measure and communicate impact of AI and automation using baseline-versus-outcome metrics.

C. Supply Solutions (Mandatory)

  • Lead structured problem-solving for supplier delay scenarios, from detection to closure.
  • Run cross-functional action plans with sourcing, planning, logistics, and supplier partners to recover at-risk orders.
  • Define and track delay recovery playbooks, including alternatives such as re-prioritization, partial allocation, and timeline resets.
  • Create and maintain early-warning indicators for supplier performance and delivery risk.
  • Drive weekly risk reviews with clear escalations, dependency management, and decision logs.
  • Recommend systemic fixes that reduce repeat delay patterns and improve planning reliability.

D. Collaboration and Capability Building

  • Partner with product and technology teams to design, test, and deploy process improvements.
  • Coach team members on structured analytics, data interpretation, and exception triage methods.
  • Ensure compliance with policies, data quality standards, and responsible AI usage principles.

Added Advantage: Apparel and Fashion Domain Knowledge

  • Understanding of apparel and fashion supply chain dynamics, including seasonality, lead-time sensitivity, and style-level variability.

  • Ability to interpret supplier and capacity constraints in the context of apparel and fashion planning cycles.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 4-6 years of relevant experience in order management, supply chain, retail, CPG, or a similar environment.
  • Advanced Excel and strong working knowledge of SQL for analysis, validation, and insight generation.

  • Experience with data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).

The Test Engineer (Mechanical) is responsible for performing, monitoring, and documenting mechanical testing activities for automotive connectors and related products. Behavioral Competencies

jobDescription:
Short Description:

Director, Enterprise Architect Enterprise API, AI Security & Governance, Engineering Excellence

Experience Level – 15+ years

Location - Ford Global Technology and Business Center (GTBC), Sholinganallur, Chennai, India (Hybrid)

Department - Enterprise Architecture (EA)

Position Type - Full-Time / Technical Leadership

Reports To - Senior Director (or) Principal Architect, Enterprise Architecture


Description:

We are seeking a director level Enterprise Architect to lead identity, API, and AI security governance across the global enterprise, operating at the intersection of cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure & platforms, and emerging AI technologies.

This role is chartered by establishing governance frameworks for MCP, APIs, Agents, and Skills, while partnering closely with platform, infrastructure, and data/AI teams to shape the future of secure, scalable AI adoption across Ford.

The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on technical credibility across cloud, AI, and security domains with the maturity of leadership to build and grow a large, cross-functional team of polyglot architects from the ground up, in a greenfield security architecture practice.


Responsibilities:

API Security Architecture

  • Design and govern secure architecture patterns for Ford's high-traffic, business-critical APIs, embedding security and governance directly into the API lifecycle.
  • Partner with platform engineering to strengthen authentication, authorization, and threat protection across the API gateway ecosystem.
  • Champion a shift-left approach to API security and compliance by embedding automated checks directly into the build phase, catching issues early in the development lifecycle. Familiarity with security tooling such as FOSSA, Cycode, 42Crunch, Cloud Armor, PRISMA is a strong plus.
  • Familiarity with open-source tools, applying buy vs build diligently and make decisions.
  • Building engineering prototypes which is kind of R&D (POC, Reference architecture), pre- implementation prototypes which are building blocks which perform in pre-production with minor tweaks.

Identity & Access Architecture

  • Architect a unified, vendor-agnostic identity fabric across Ford's global enterprise, resolving the complexity of a multi-IdP environment while eliminating vendor lock-in.
  • Define modern application authorization patterns — including OAuth On-Behalf-Of (OBO) flows and delegated access models — that scale securely across applications, APIs, and AI agents.
  • Establish governance standards spanning workforce, customer, and machine/non-human identities.

AI & Agent Security Governance

  • Define and enforce enterprise-wide governance frameworks for MCP, APIs, Agents, and Skills.
  • Partner with the Platform team (EPEO) to evaluate and govern the enterprise, AI Gateway.
  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of the agent-building ecosystem — low-code/no-code and pro-code options using Microsoft and Gemini Enterprise, plus hands-on expertise in the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) — to guide secure, scalable agent adoption.
  • Collaborate with GDAI and data/AI teams to keep governance aligned with the pace of enterprise AI innovation.

Engineering Excellence – Patterns & Reference Architecture

  • Design and publish reusable patterns and reference architectures for AI solutions, giving teams across Ford consistent, secure building blocks rather than ad-hoc implementations.
  • Build starter apps/templates for the Google ADK, providing pro-code agent developers a secure, governed foundation to build from.
  • Define reference implementations mapping OAuth OBO flows with Microsoft Agent ID, ensuring agents securely act on behalf of users with proper identity context and audit trails.
  • Continuously evolve these patterns as Microsoft, Google, and other providers update their agent identity and authorization models.
  • Ensure starter kits and patterns are pre-approved, governance-compliant building blocks reducing time-to-production for new AI use cases.

Cloud & Infrastructure Architecture

  • Lead strategy for multi-cloud interoperability, ensuring consistent, portable security architecture across cloud providers.
  • Maintain a strong command of GCP architecture — scalability, resiliency, and cost/FinOps — to guide sound, cost-conscious infrastructure decisions. Partnering with FinOps EPEO team for the cost of architecture.
  • Partner with cybersecurity and EPEO infrastructure teams to ensure governance controls are technically enforceable across tooling and platforms.
  • Architect security solutions that directly protect and enable Ford's core business platforms — eCommerce, Ford Credit (global banking and financial services), and global retail/commercial fleet customer platforms.
  • Balance security rigor with speed-to-market for digital initiatives.

Applied AI & Insights

  • Apply predictive AI models to real enterprise use cases, delivering actionable insights that inform security, architecture, and business strategy.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner closely with cybersecurity, platform (EPEO), infrastructure, and data/AI(GDAI) teams to align governance and reference architectures with evolving platform capabilities and enterprise roadmaps.
  • Serve as a key architectural liaison between security, engineering, and business stakeholders.

Team Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a cross-functional team of 20+ polyglot architects (Java, UI, AI, Python, GCP).
  • Build a culture of Engineering Excellence — driving technical rigor, continuous learning, and cross-skilling.
  • Set team goals and objectives, priorities, and development paths aligned with enterprise architecture measure success by defining OKRs and KPIs.

Strategic Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a Director-level technical authority on identity, API, and AI security governance, representing Enterprise Architecture in senior technical and business forums.
  • Proactively shape Ford's approach to secure, scalable AI adoption — anticipating emerging risks and technologies ahead of business impact.

Qualifications:

Required Qualifications

  • 15+ years of progressive experience in enterprise architecture, cybersecurity architecture, or platform engineering, including significant time in identity & access management (IAM) and API security architecture.
  • Proven, hands-on experience architecting multi-IdP identity environments, with deep knowledge of protocols such as OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML — including practical implementation of OBO (On-Behalf-Of) flows and delegated authorization patterns.
  • Demonstrated experience with API gateway architecture, threat protection, and API lifecycle governance at enterprise scale.

About the Role

VRTEKH (Vishnu Roopini Films) is a film production house building at the intersection of traditional storytelling and generative AI.

We are looking for someone who is exceptional at creating AI content generating high-quality AI images and videos and who will also edit those videos into finished, release-ready pieces. You'll be genuinely obsessed with using every AI platform available to produce films and online content, and skilled enough on a timeline to cut it all together professionally.

You'll create AI visuals and edit trailers, shorts, promos, social content and hybrid AI-generated films generating original AI content and stitching it together with live-action, VFX plates and audio into polished final videos.

What This Role Is Really About (Most Important)

  • Generate top-quality AI visuals: Produce sharp, cinematic, consistent AI images and videos film-grade, not generic outputs.
  • Edit the videos end-to-end: Take that AI-generated (and live-action) material and edit it into finished videos — assembling, cutting, pacing and finishing to a professional standard.
  • Master every AI platform: Be keen and fearless about using all possible AI tools — image, video, upscaling, relighting, lip-sync, voice — to create films and online content.
  • Prompt like a pro: Write, refine and iterate prompts to get usable, consistent, high-quality results and troubleshoot when a tool fights back.
  • Push creative limits: Constantly experiment to find what produces the best-looking, most original AI-generated content — and raise the bar every time.

What You'll Do

  • Create & edit end-to-end: Generate AI content, then edit and finish trailers, shorts, promos, reels and long-form pieces from raw, AI-generated and live-action material.
  • Edit for impact: Cut, sequence and pace footage; handle transitions, timing and story flow to keep every piece engaging start to finish.
  • Blend live-action with AI: Seamlessly integrate AI-generated shots, B-roll and VFX into traditional footage so the seams don't show.
  • Own the AI workflow: Generate, iterate on and refine shots across multiple AI platforms.
  • Craft sound & pace: Handle music, SFX, AI voiceover, dialogue sync, color and pacing to a professional finish.
  • Deliver to spec: Export clean masters and platform-specific cuts (16:9, 9:16, 1:1) on time and on brief.

What You Bring

  • Proven AI content creation — you've actually generated high-quality AI images and videos and shipped real work with them. (#1 must-have.)
  • Strong video editing skills — you can cut, sequence and finish videos to a professional standard, not just generate clips. (Equally essential.)
  • A genuine passion for AI tools — eager to master every platform and stay ahead of a stack that changes weekly.
  • Command of story, rhythm, timing and visual storytelling.
  • Fluency in a pro NLE — Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro (After Effects a plus).
  • A self-starter mindset — curious, experimental, deadline-aware and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Attention to detail — clean cuts, correct color, synced audio, and consistent characters and continuity across AI shots.
  • Your own laptop — this is an in-office role; candidates who can bring their own laptop will be preferred.

AI Platforms You'll Likely Work With

You should be at home in this world and eager to master more:

  • Video generation: Runway, Kling, Higgsfield, Google Veo / Seedance, Luma Dream Machine, Pika, Sora
  • Image generation: Midjourney, Nano Banana / Google Imagen, Flux, Stable Diffusion
  • Enhancement & finishing: Topaz Video AI, Magnific, upscaling / relighting / reframing tools
  • Audio & voice: ElevenLabs, Suno, and AI voiceover / lip-sync tools

Bonus Points

  • Motion graphics / VFX compositing (After Effects, Nuke, Fusion)

  • A strong public portfolio experimenting with AI filmmaking

title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality Engineering
jobDescription:
Your Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will build and own the frameworks, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that let Alpaca s engineers ship new features quickly and reliably. This is a software engineering role at its core: you will spend most of your time writing Go, designing automated test frameworks, and digging into application code and Kubernetes when needed. Just as importantly, you will help redefine how we use AI to raise the bar on quality - leveraging LLMs and AI-driven tooling to generate tests, catch regressions before they ship, and turn every incident into durable, automated coverage. We are looking for engineers who treat quality as an engineering discipline and see AI as a force multiplier for it - people who build the systems that make testing fast, reliable, and effortless for the teams that depend on them.

Things You Get To Do
  • Design and build automated test frameworks across our REST and gRPC API surface.
  • Leverage AI and LLM-based tooling to accelerate test generation, harden regression coverage, and turn production incidents into automated tests - embedding these practices into the frameworks the whole engineering org relies on.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - we use a mix of GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build.
  • Design and execute load, stress, and scalability tests to ensure our platform can handle growing demand.
  • Introduce chaos engineering practices - designing fault-injection and resilience experiments that surface failure modes before our customers do.
  • Standardize tooling and infrastructure to improve the day-to-day developer experience.
  • Partner with other teams to raise test coverage, reliability, and speed across services.
  • Dig into application code to root-cause failures and drive fixes to completion.
  • Mentor and guide product engineers, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.
Who You Are (Must-Haves)
  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and maintaining production systems.
  • You have written code in strongly typed languages and have at least 1 year of experience with Go.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted engineering - you actively use LLM-based tools in your workflow and have a clear point of view on where they elevate quality (and where they don t).
  • You have built and maintained CI pipelines before - ideally with GitHub Actions or Google Cloud Build.
  • You have designed and built automated test frameworks, and you understand the challenges microservices pose for reliable integration and end-to-end testing.
  • You are familiar with Kubernetes beyond the basics - you can write a Helm chart for a new service with relative ease, you understand best practices around security, and you have prior job experience or certifications to prove this.
  • You have worked at a startup before - you understand that things don t always go according to plan, that there is significant technical debt, that some tasks just need to be done, and that sometimes there are no processes or documentation to guide your hand.
  • You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.
Who You Might Be (Bonus Points)
  • You have used AI/LLM tooling to build QA automation - test generation, flaky-test triage, or incident-to-regression pipelines - and can speak to what worked and what didn t.
  • You have written code in Python or TypeScript, and can build efficient Dockerfiles and secure container images.
  • You have implemented load tests with k6 (REST) and ghz (gRPC) and have experience analyzing pprof/trace output.
  • You have done IaC deployments with Argo CD or Terraform, or have used Google Cloud Platform and Google Kubernetes Engine before. You are familiar with Tilt and have written a Kubernetes Operator before.
  • You have practiced chaos engineering - running fault-injection or resilience experiments with tools like Chaos Mesh, LitmusChaos, or Gremlin.
  • You are familiar with testing event-driven systems using Kafka (or even better, Redpanda).

 Base location: Corporate Services Department (CSD), Mumbai — with frequent and extended travel to Kores plants
 Experience: 0–2 years.
Fresh graduates and early-career hires welcome. Strong fundamentals, trainable, willing to spend significant time at plants.
 Positions open: 2 About the Role The Digital Transformation Cell is hiring two AI & Process Automation Trainees to take our work directly to the plants. You will spend significant time at Kores manufacturing sites — understanding how processes actually run today, mapping them as flowcharts and SOPs, identifying where AI and automation can take real work off plant teams' plates, and then building and rolling out those solutions. This is a hands-on, end-to-end role: you own a problem discovery through SOP, build, training and adoption. You will use AI tools (LLMs, agents, copilots, no-code platforms) as your everyday toolkit, and work alongside the wider DT Cell — Power BI, Zoho CRM, SAP, Redshift — to integrate what you build into the broader stack. We are not looking for ready-made experts. We are looking for sharp, curious people who can learn the plants, love working with new AI tools, write clearly, and stay with a problem until it's actually solved on the ground.

 Key Responsibilities - Plant Engagement & Process Discovery Capture the as-is process— including the workarounds, exceptions and tribal knowledge that never make it into formal documentation. Build trust with plant teams so they bring their real problems to you, not the polished version.

 Kores DT Cell |  Process Mapping & SOP Digitization Produce clear process flowcharts— and maintain them in a central, version-controlled repository. Use AI tools to accelerate documentation — turning raw notes and recordings into structured SOP drafts, surfacing inconsistencies Maintain a 'process maturity' tracker for each plant: which processes are mapped, which have signed-off SOPs, which are automated, and what's next. Surface where the same process is done differently across plants and help the team converge on a common standard. AI & Automation Build Convert SOPs and prioritised opportunities into working automations using the right tool for the job Build AI-powered solutions for plant operations Integrate automations with the existing Kores stack Build, test and deploy in tight iterations Rollout, Training & Adoption Train plant teams on new SOPs and digital tools — and stay with each rollout until adoption is real, not just go-live. Write clear, user-friendly documentation for everything you ship. Resolve issues and incorporate user feedback in the weeks following each rollout. Team Contribution Work as a pair on plant engagements with the second hire under this role — and collaborate closely with the rest of the DT Cell. Stay on top of the AI/automation tooling landscape — proactively bring new capabilities (new LLMs, agent frameworks, no-code platforms) to the team and pilot them on real Kores problems. Maintain code, prompts, workflows and documentation in version-controlled, reusable form so the team can build on each other's work. Run periodic internal demos to share what you've learned with the wider DT Cell.

 Must-Have Qualifications -  Bachelor's degree in any engineering discipline — Computer Science, IT, AI/ML, Data Science, Industrial, Mechanical, Production, Electronics, or related. MBA in Operations is a plus. Hands-on experience with at least one programming language (Python preferred) Practical, demonstrable experience building with AI tools — class projects, hackathons, internships, side projects all count. We want to see you've actually built something, not just read about it. Familiarity with at least one automation or no-code/low-code platform Strong interest in process design, manufacturing operations, or industrial engineering — formal exposure (coursework, Lean / Six Sigma, internships) is a plus, genuine curiosity is essential. Comfortable spending 20–30% of time at plants — including shop-floor conditions, shift timings where required, and travel across Kores sites. Clear written and spoken communication

 Nice to Have Internship or project experience in a manufacturing plant, foundry, pharmaceutical facility or similar industrial environment. Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or similar process certification. Hands-on experience with agent frameworks & Claude AI Exposure to ERP (SAP) workflows or CRM (Zoho) — even basic familiarity helps. Cloud platform familiarity (AWS / Azure / GCP). Github profile, blog, hackathon record or open-source contribution that shows your work.

 Why This Role

 Real ownership from day one — you'll be on plant floors, talking to operations team and shipping things people use. You will be the person bringing the latest LLMs, agents and copilots to a 90-year-old manufacturing group. Cross-vertical exposure — work across foundries, stationery, pharma and engineering, not stuck in one division. Direct line to leadership — the DT Cell reports into the Joint Managing Director's office. Strong mentorship — a small, senior team that will invest in your growth.

jobDescription:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We''re all in on this mission. If you are too, let''s talk.
Get to know Okta
Okta is The World''s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology, anywhere, on any device or app. Our flexible and neutral products, Okta Platform and Auth0 Platform, provide secure access, authentication, and automation, placing identity at the core of business security and growth.
At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box we''re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.
Join our team! We''re building a world where Identity belongs to you.
Auth0 is an easy-to-implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier-0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.
The Engineering Architect Team
The Architecture team is a small group of very senior engineers reporting to our VP of Engineering Excellence, working broadly across the organization in collaboration with Engineering, Product, and Security. We partner deeply with other Engineering teams for large projects, and provide direction and architectural guidance for smaller initiatives. We have a dual-pronged charter to "level up the tech stack and level up the people stack" via both technical contributions and partnerships and mentoring.
The Role
Auth0 is a developer product at its core and increasingly, the developers building with us aren''t just humans. AI agents are now a first-class consumer of our SDKs, APIs, and documentation.
This role owns the architectural vision for how Auth0 is experienced across three dimensions: DX (Developer Experience how human developers build with Auth0), UX (User Experience how users experience Auth0 products), and AX (Agentic Experience how AI agents interact with and build on Auth0).
You''ll work across our SDK ecosystem, public APIs, documentation, and product surfaces to ensure that every touchpoint is consistent, delightful, and easy to build on whether the builder is a human or an agent.
You''ll also contribute directly to how we build internally: creating the skills, guardrails, and patterns that our own in-house agents use, ensuring that agent-assisted development at Auth0 produces the same high-quality, consistent output as human-led development.
What you''ll be doing
  • Define and drive the architectural vision for DX, UX, and AX across Auth0''s public products, SDKs, and APIs
  • Identify and address inconsistencies across Auth0''s product surfaces, establishing patterns and standards that make the experience feel unified and intentional
  • Architect and contribute to the SDK and API design layer, ensuring our developer-facing interfaces are ergonomic, consistent, and built for both human and agent consumers
  • Design and build agent skills, guardrails, and contextual tooling (MCP servers, SKILL.md, llms.txt, structured documentation) that enable agents to build correctly with Auth0
  • Embed within Engineering teams for large initiatives, providing architectural guidance and lighter-touch direction for smaller efforts
  • Partner closely with the Design team as a key stakeholder, ensuring engineering implementation reflects and reinforces the product''s UX direction
  • Contribute to Auth0''s Developer Experience Principles in practice not just as guidance, but through hands-on implementation that raises the bar
  • Lead by doing: reviewing, prototyping, and contributing code across SDKs, tooling, and documentation systems
  • Participate in our Engineering Leadership Team with other architects, directors, and executives
  • Mentor and uplevel engineers across the organization on experience-focused architecture
What you''ll bring to the role
  • Experience : 15 to 20 year .
  • Deep experience designing developer-facing products: SDKs, APIs, CLIs, documentation systems, or developer portals
  • A strong point of view on what great DX looks like and the ability to identify, articulate, and fix where it falls short
  • Familiarity with the emerging AX space: agent-readable documentation formats, MCP servers, agent skills, and how AI agents consume APIs and tooling auth0.com
  • Knowledge of Identity protocols such as OAuth, OIDC, and SAML, and how they surface in developer-facing products
  • Experience working across multiple product surfaces to drive consistency you''ve seen what fragmentation looks like and know how to fix it
  • Hands-on coding ability: this is not a purely advisory role; you''ll be expected to build, prototype, and contribute directly
  • Very strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence engineers, product managers, and designers
  • Ability to drive technical decisions to conclusion while balancing quality, velocity, and pragmatism
